rationale: C15 is a clear material drafting template for the child. Both are annual nationwide memoranda concerning the same campaigns and follow the same sequence: describe the fall appeals and participating charities, quantify the fundraising goal, affirm the Federal community's responsibility, identify a Cabinet officer as Federal Vice Chairman, and request cooperation under the Federal fund-raising policy. The child also closely reuses C15's distinctive language about Government personnel assuming their share of support and the campaigns providing an opportunity to support many private health and welfare organizations. C18 and C11 are strong earlier members of the same drafting lineage, but their wording is less directly reflected in the child than C15's.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This fall, United Funds and Community Chests make their annual appeals ... for the support of many thousands of charitable organizations. These include such national agencies as the Red Cross, USO, and those working to eliminate disease
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This Fall more than 2,000 United Funds and Community Chests will make their appeals for the support of over 23,000 health, welfare and recreation organizations. Many of these campaigns will include the needs of such national agencies as the Red Cross, USO and those fighting the dread diseases and other health problems.
shared_material.explanation: The opening is a condensed adaptation preserving the campaign, timing, supported organizations, and distinctive examples.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For these splendid purposes, they seek to raise more than $380,000,000.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: These united community campaigns will be seeking to raise more than $340,000,000.
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same fundraising-goal sentence while updating the annual amount.

shared_material.child_excerpt: We, in Government, want to assume our full share of support of the many private health and welfare organizations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We who work in the Government want to assume our full citizen's share of voluntary support of the many worthwhile private health and welfare organizations.
shared_material.explanation: This is close, distinctive verbal reuse with modest compression.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The United Fund and Community Chest campaigns provide us with an opportunity for exercising the traditional American quality of neighborliness.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The United Fund and Community Chest campaigns provide us with an opportunity for supporting a wide variety and a large number of organizations through a single appeal.
shared_material.explanation: The same sentence frame and subject are reused, with a new statement of the opportunity's civic meaning.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Honorable Marion B. Folsom ... will serve as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government of United Community Campaigns. Under the recently adopted Federal policy on voluntary fund-raising, I am confident everyone will extend full cooperation to the Vice Chairman
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have approved the appointment of the Honorable George M. Humphrey ... as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government of United Community Campaigns. In the spirit of true voluntary giving I am confident that you will extend the full cooperation ... under the new uniform Federal policy on fund raising
shared_material.explanation: The same administrative machinery and closely parallel language are retained while the officeholder and phrasing are updated.
